policy: All dependency and toolchain lockfiles must be committed. A missing, invalid, or drifted lockfile fails the supply-chain gate.

lockfiles.purpose: Rust workspace dependency graph lock (crates.io, git, and path sources) for the workspace and excluded spike workspaces.
Locked toolchain versions for Rust, Node, npm, .NET/Windows App SDK, Swift/Xcode, Kotlin/Gradle, and GTK.
